answer: Stop sybils with a nadir, a lotus, and a delta. Each identity must grow one lotus: a sequential memory-hard proof chained to the epoch pulse, taking wall-clock time no box can parallelize. A lotus counts only if vouched by distinct identities, and each vouch drains the voucher toward the nadir by a delta growing with every vouch given, so the k-th clone from one purse costs k times the first and a farm of N pays N squared. If one lotus cheats, its path is cut at the nadir and all standing above it burns. One honest agent risks one proof; a clone farm pays quadratic tolls for one field.
